      "name": "Licenses",
      "description": "The license describes a customer account. Contains:\n - [Subscription](#tag/Subscriptions) information (selected plan, number of agent slots)\n - Global license settings\n - Default team designation. The default team is selected among all teams and serves as a default/fallback mechanism, every place team can't be determined or hasn't been specified\n - Default template. The default template is served if the team hasn't got its own template set\n"
    },
    {
      "name": "Agents",
      "description": "Agent represent single agent account on a license. Contains:\n  - teams agent belongs to\n  - agent individual settings like notification preferences, avatars etc.\n  - agent role (`owner`, `normal`, `viewer`)\n"
    },
    {
      "name": "Custom fields",
      "description": "Custom fields are customer defined fields in ticket. Tickets are created in license scope, visibility is set per team(s). \n\nThere are four types of custom fields (single line, multi line, url and date). \n\nEvery custom field has edit permission level:\n- normal, value editable by any agent in tickets view\n- owner, value editable by admins only in tickets view\n- read only, value not editable on interface, only via API\n\nEvery custom field can be deactivated (hidden in interface).\n\nAmount of active custom fields is limited per license in license settings by `maxCustomFieldsActive` value.\n\nOnly custom field that is not used in any ticket can be deleted.\n"
    },
    {
      "name": "Transactions",
      "description": "\nTransactions represent volatile sets of uploaded attachments used while modifying various elements in HelpDesk such as ticket messages, agent signatures etc.\n\n## Basic flow\n\nTransactions are volatile. Transaction exists only until it is used in another `POST` or `PATCH` method. Unused transactions are purged after 24 hours along with uploaded attachments with exception of \"external\" attachments i.e. attachments copied from another entities like agent signatures etc.\n\nTransactions have types. Currently `ticket`, `agent`, `templateLogo` and `cannedResponse`. The type determines path of uploaded attachment and the entity in which it can be used.\n\nUpon creation, transaction needs entity ID and can only be used in this entity afterwards - this allows to keep consistent naming in S3 paths. The exception to this rule is creating transaction for a ticket, template or canned response that don't exist yet. In this case entity ID should not be provided - it will be generated automatically and will determine final ID of created ticket, template or canned response.\n\n### Create transaction\n\n```\nPOST /v1/transactions\n\n{\n    // only one field allowed:\n    \"ticketID\": \"UUID\", // do not add when ticket does not exist yet\n    \"agentID\": \"UUID\", // use when uploading attachments for agent signature\n    \"templateID\": \"UUID\", // do not add when template does not exist yet\n    \"cannedResponseID\": \"UUID\", // do not add when canned resposne does not exist yet\n}\n```\n\nThis yields:\n\n```\n{\n\"ID\": \"9a1e8a52-e7f2-4f59-8b45-a1643d28c460\",\n\"type\": \"ticket\",\n\"createdAt\": \"2020-03-24T13:58:12.288Z\",\n\"attachments\": []\n}\n```\n\n### Upload file\n\n```\nPOST /v1/transactions/9a1e8a52-e7f2-4f59-8b45-a1643d28c460/attachments\n```\n\nUse multipart with `attachments` as key. Multiple files are allowed.\n\nResult:\n\n```\n[\n{\n    \"ID\": \"af367f6b-5b8b-4468-a2ef-4990114d968a\",\n    \"cid\": \"af367f6b-5b8b-4468-a2ef-4990114d968a\",\n    \"url\": \"https://cdn-labs.livechat-static.com/api/file/helpdesk/att/1338/9a1e8a52-e7f2-4f59-8b45-a1643d28c460/9ce3d7c1ada659d0cf2da321ef41a4628192875aa7e0c80627b4243140ab02ae/earl.png\",\n    \"name\": \"earl.png\",\n    \"type\": \"image/png\",\n    \"size\": 25670\n}\n]\n```\n\n### Remove uploaded file from transaction\n\n```\nDELETE /v1/transactions/9a1e8a52-e7f2-4f59-8b45-a1643d28c460/attachments/af367f6b-5b8b-4468-a2ef-4990114d968a\n```\n\nResult:\n\n```\n\"OK\"\n```\n\n### Add attachments from agent signature\n\n```\nPOST /v1/transactions/6456b4e5-1e8f-4029-86f7-1e534d020225/attachments\n\n{\n\"agentID\": \"GUID\" // copy attachments from this agent's signature\n}\n```\n\nResult:\n\n```\n[\n{\n    \"ID\": \"44b004b7-2efd-4f73-b9f5-ac927816f18b\",\n    \"cid\": \"44b004b7-2efd-4f73-b9f5-ac927816f18b\",\n    \"url\": \"https://cdn-labs.livechat-static.com/api/file/helpdesk/att/1338/agent/ff623067-ba81-4613-bfa8-1c558e3a58f0/9ce3d7c1ada659d0cf2da321ef41a4628192875aa7e0c80627b4243140ab02ae/earl.png\",\n    \"name\": \"earl.png\",\n    \"type\": \"image/png\",\n    \"size\": 25670\n},\n{\n    \"ID\": \"a1fbb278-0bca-4eba-baa8-48cc9d1f1abc\",\n    \"cid\": \"a1fbb278-0bca-4eba-baa8-48cc9d1f1abc\",\n    \"url\": \"https://cdn-labs.livechat-static.com/api/file/helpdesk/att/1338/agent/ff623067-ba81-4613-bfa8-1c558e3a58f0/9ce3d7c1ada659d0cf2da321ef41a4628192875aa7e0c80627b4243140ab02ae/earl.png\",\n    \"name\": \"earl.png\",\n    \"type\": \"image/png\",\n    \"size\": 25670\n}\n]\n```\n\n## Common tasks\n\n### Change attachments in agent signature\n\n1. Create transaction of type `agent`\n\n```\nPOST /v1/transactions HTTP/1.1\n\nagentID=ff623067-ba81-4613-bfa8-1c558e3a58f0\n```\n\n2. Upload attachments\n\n3. Update signature using `transactionID`\n\n```\nPATCH /v1/agents/ff623067-ba81-4613-bfa8-1c558e3a58f0 HTTP/1.1\n\nsignature.text=test\ntransactionID=6efd3115-cf6e-4b2c-83d1-03fa5470c625\n```\n"
    },
    {
      "name": "Email domains",
      "description": "Email domain represent a domain with records authorizing HelpDesk to send emails on behalf of email owner. This allows for using original license owner domain for ticket communication. To achieve seamless end-user experience, additional setup of mailboxes (inboxes) and reply addresses is required."
    },
    {
      "name": "Subscriptions",
      "description": "Subscription represent currently selected plan and number of paid agent slots. Changing these parameters **will cuase credit card to be charged**."
    },
    {
      "name": "Teams",
      "description": "Teams group agents. Every ticket is always assigned to specific team. At any given time one of the teams has to be designated as a default (fallback) team.\n"
    },
    {
      "name": "Templates",
      "description": "Teamplate describes HTML (or Visual) and plaintext version of every email sent to end-user. Templates can be used to customize these messages.\n"
    },
    {
      "name": "Audit log",
      "description": "Audit log contains all changes made in the system.\n"
    },
    {
      "name": "Mailboxes (inboxes)",
      "description": "Mailboxes (inboxes) are virtual email addresses provided by HelpDesk as an entry point for all email communcation. All messages that create tickets should be forwarded to one of the mailboxes. Each mailbox can be set to route incomming tickets to specific teams and optionally agents. Mailbox can also have a reply address customized allowing reply to be sent from different `From` address for each mailbox.\n\nDefault mailbox is built in and can't be removed. It also won't be listed in `GET` responses.\n"
    },
    {
      "name": "Reply addresses",
      "description": "Reply addresses are created automatically when configuring a mailbox with custom reply address. When this happens, an automatic verification message is being sent to verify, that reply address correctly forwards messages back to one of the mailboxes. This is to ensure that end-user will always be able to reply to agent's message."
    },
    {
      "name": "Spam management",
      "description": "Trusting and blocking emails/domains can be used to force message from specific sender to spam (block) or ignore spam filters (trust). In case of conflicting entries, more specific entry has precedence over more general (email is more important than domain). Adding an address or a domain to one list automatically removes it from the other."
    },
    {
      "name": "Canned responses",
      "description": "Canned responses represent short templates of replies fragments that can be used during message composition in the app."
    },
    {
      "name": "Rules",
      "description": "Rules allow automated processing of tickets. Rules are executed for every ticket during creation or any change that modifies the ticket. A rule consists of conditions (triggers) and actions. When every (or any - depending on quantifier) trigger is fulfilled, all action in the rule are being performed."
    },
    {
      "name": "Macros",
      "description": "Macros enable batch processing of tickets. A macro consists of several actions. When a user triggers a macro, all the actions within it are executed on the ticket. The number of macros is limited to 20 shared macros per license and 20 private macros per user."
    },
    {
      "name": "Views",
      "description": "Views are materialized ticket filters. Every ticket filter set can be saved as a view. Views are created per agent."
    },
    {
      "name": "Webhooks",
      "description": "Webhooks represent HTTP addresses that are being requested every time an event occurs.\nWebhook payload for `tickets.*` webhooks (`POST` request with `application/json` payload):\n```\n    {\n        eventType: <webhook event type>,\n        createdAt: <webhook event timestamp>,\n        payload: {\n            <new ticket content>\n        }\n    }\n```\n\nWebhook payload for `tickets.events.*` webhooks (`POST` request with `application/json` payload):\n```\n    {\n        eventType: <webhook event type>,\n        createdAt: <webhook event timestamp>,\n        payload: {\n            ticket: <new ticket content>\n            event: <the event content>\n        }\n    }\n```\n\nSupported events:\n\n| Event type | Description |\n|-|-|\n| `tickets.create` | New ticket was created |\n| `tickets.update` | Ticket was modified |\n| `tickets.statusChange` | Ticket's status changed (deprecated - please use `tickets.events.status` instead) |\n| `tickets.events.status` | Ticket's status changed |\n| `tickets.events.priority` | Ticket's priority changed |\n| `tickets.events.message` | New message in ticket |\n| `tickets.events.tags` | Ticket's tags changed |\n| `tickets.events.followers` | Ticket's followers changed |\n| `tickets.events.assignment` | Ticket's assignment changed |\n\n\nThe request will be retried for about 24 hours with increasing interval in case endpoint responds with HTTP code different than `200`.\n"
    }
  ],

      "EmailDomainBase": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "example": "weyland-yutani.com",
            "description": "Email domain name.\n\nIf only fragment is provided, the `name.helpdesk.com` domain will be created. If full domain is provided, ownership verification will be performed during this API call. The system will look for `CNAME` record with hostname of `hd-<licenseID>.yourdomain.com` pointing to `helpdesk.com`. The request will fail if no such record is found.\n"
          }
        }
      },
      "EmailDomainResult": {
        "allOf": [
          {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ObjectBase"
          },
          {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/EmailDomainBase"
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "status": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "new",
                  "pendingConfiguration",
                  "pendingVerification",
                  "active",
                  "pendingDeletion",
                  "setupFailed"
                ],
                "description": "Domain status\n\n| Status | Description |\n|-|-|\n| `new` | domain just added |\n| `pendingConfiguration` | domain need additional records in DNS |\n| `pendingVerification` | domain is being verified |\n| `active` | domain is ready to use |\n| `setupFailed` | domain setup failed - manual steps required |\n"
              },
              "dns": {
                "type": "object",
                "description": "DNS records that have to be set in domain DNS",
                "properties": {
                  "TXT": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "host": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "pm-bounces.livechatinc.com"
                        },
                        "value": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "pm.mtasv.net"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "CNAME": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "host": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "20200212092056pm._domainkey.livechatinc.com"
                        },
                        "value": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "k=rsa; p=MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQCmpdz31Mee4R2wdh/2SbapQRiUsTg+gi6IyyOUopKxBf5OqFXI4YIvxIisMIHWs1t2QBb5/StR6a1Tp5H3YxJ/ooMeto2+GsZVbolMX9Tl/gKyP/+9hJD+OWoxi7IzY/SYj0rE9BgmrUdam+Nkm7emFZHK2LbkhEow5XPoFPD50QIDAQAB"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "flags": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "inboxUsed": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "description": "There was an email forwarded to this domain"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      "EmailDomainCreate": {
        "allOf": [
          {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/EmailDomainBase"
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "required": [
              "name"
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      "properties-name": {
        "type": "string",
        "example": "weyland-yutani.com",
        "description": "Email domain name.\n\nIf only fragment is provided, the `name.helpdesk.com` domain will be created. If full domain is provided, ownership verification will be performed during this API call. The system will look for `CNAME` record with hostname of `hd-<licenseID>.yourdomain.com` pointing to `helpdesk.com`. The request will fail if no such record is found.\n"
      },

          "name": {

            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "text": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Template text version"
              },
              "html": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Template HTML or Visual version"
              },
              "appearance": {
                "type": "object",
                "description": "Template appearance object. Describes what variables, and with which values, will be replaced in the template. Variables should be placed in the `html` property in Mustache format with custom delimiters `<%%` and `%%>`). If template type is `visual`, then `appearance` is required.",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "description": "Variable that will be replaced in the template. Key is a variable name, that should be placed in the `html` property in Mustache format with custom delimiters `<%%` and `%%>`.",
                  "properties": {
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "color",
                        "url",
                        "richTextObj",
                        "boolean"
                      ]
                    },
                    "value": {
                      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AnyValue",
                      "description": "According to `type` value should be: \n- `color` - hex color string \n- `url` - url string \n- `richTextObj` - rich text object \n- `boolean` - boolean value"
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "text",
              "html"
            ]
          },
          "type": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "html",
              "visual"
            ],
            "description": "Template type",
            "example": "html"
          }
        }
      },

            },
            "to": {
              "type": "string",

            }

        "name": "authorType",
        "description": "Type of author of action",
        "required": false,
        "schema": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "administrator",
            "agent",
            "api",
            "scheduledTask",
            "emailMessage",
            "paymentProvider",
            "helpdeskSystem"
          ]
        }
      },
      "authorID": {
        "in": "query",
        "name": "authorID",
        "description": "authors uuid",
        "schema": {
          "type": "string",
          "example": "42e113f9-9353-4e89-9f68-69b92f423b0c",
          "description": "Unique object identifier",
          "format": "uuid"
        }
      },
      "timezone": {
        "in": "query",
        "name": "timezone",
        "description": "Timezone",
        "schema": {
          "type": "string",
          "default": "UTC"
        }
      }
    }
  },

    "/v1/reports": {
      "post": {
        "operationId": "reportsCreate",
        "summary": "Create custom report",
        "tags": [
          "Reports"
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "raw"
                    ],
                    "description": "Report type. Must be `raw`."
                  },
                  "recipients": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "description": "Report recipients will receive link to CSV file with generated report.",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "email",
                      "description": "Report recipient email address"
                    }
                  },
                  "range": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "description": "Report time range",
                    "properties": {
                      "timezone": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "default": "UTC"
                      },
                      "from": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "format": "date",
                        "description": "Absolute date or [relative date](#section/Common-notions/Relative-dates-and-datetime-ranges)\n"
                      },
                      "to": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "format": "date",
                        "description": "Absolute date or [relative date](#section/Common-notions/Relative-dates-and-datetime-ranges)\n"
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "created report",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ReportResult"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },

    "/v1/tickets": {
      "get": {
        "operationId": "ticketList",
        "summary": "List tickets",
        "tags": [
          "Tickets"
        ],
        "parameters": [
          {
            "in": "query",
            "name": "status",
            "schema": {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TicketStatus"
            },
            "description": "Ticket status"
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "name": "spam",
            "schema": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "default": false
            },
            "description": "Include spam tickets"
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "name": "subject",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "description": "Ticket subject"
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "name": "customFields",
            "schema": {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TicketCustomFields"
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "name": "customFieldsExist[]",
            "schema": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "example": [
                  "order-id"
                ]
              }
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "name": "teamIDs[]",
            "explode": false,
            "schema": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ID"
              }
            },
            "description": "List of teams ticket is visible to"
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "name": "requester",
            "schema": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "email": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "Requester's email",
                  "example": "some@email.com"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "email"
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Is agent assigned",
            "name": "hasAssignee",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "Y",
                "N",
                "0",
                "1"
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Is ticket merged to parent ticket",
            "name": "hasParent",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "Y",
                "N",
                "0",
                "1"
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Are tags present",
            "name": "hasTags",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "Y",
                "N",
                "0",
                "1"
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Ticket short ID",
            "name": "shortID",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Full text search query",
            "name": "query",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Parent ticket ID",
            "name": "parentTicketID",
            "schema": {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ID"
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Required tags",
            "name": "tagIDs[]",
            "explode": false,
            "schema": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ID"
              }
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Ticket follower",
            "name": "follower",
            "schema": {
              "oneOf": [
                {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ID"
                },
                {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "ME"
                  ],
                  "description": "special value ME marks currently logged agent"
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Ticket rating",
            "name": "rate",
            "schema": {
              "oneOf": [
                {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TicketRating"
                },
                {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "- `any`: ticket is rated\n- `none`: ticket is not rated\"\n",
                  "enum": [
                    "any",
                    "none"
                  ]
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Ticket priority",
            "name": "priority",
            "schema": {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TicketPriority"
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "name": "priorityOp",
            "description": "Ticket priority operator",
            "schema": {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TicketPriorityOperator"
            }
          },
          {
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Ticket assignment",
            "name": "assignment",
            "schema": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "team": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "description": "Assigned team",
                  "properties": {
                    "ID": {
                      "oneOf": [
                        {
                          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ID",
                          "description": "Assigned team"
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "array",
                          "description": "List of assigned teams",
                          "items": {
                            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ID"
                          },
                          "minItems": 1
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [

                          ],
                          "description": "Any team the agent is a member of"

                "agent": {

                  "description": "Assigned agent",

    "/v1/importedTickets": {
      "post": {
        "operationId": "importedTicketsCreate",
        "summary": "Create imported ticket",
        "description": "By default this endpoint creates a **ticket without attachments**.\nIf you want to create a ticket containing attachments:\n1. Create new import transaction by issuing `POST` request to `/v1/importedTickets/transactions` endpoint\n2. Upload attachments by issuing `POST` request(s) to `/v1/importedTickets/attachments` with proper `transactionID` acquired in step 1. The response will contain array with `attachmentIDs` you can use in step 3.\n3. Create new ticket issuing `POST` request to `/v1/importedTickets` endpoint with additional `transactionID` parameter acquired in step 1\n\nRemarks:\n- First event has to be of type `message`\n- Date of first message event is considered ticket creating date\n- Events have to be chronologically ordered and in the past\n- Events of type `message` and `attachments` are grouped together when the date parameter in both events match `attachment.files` array contains IDs generated during attachment upload\n- All uploaded attachments have to be used during ticket import\n- `TransactionID` stays valid for 24 hours\n- Ticket status can be changed using status event (last such status is used as final status)\n- Agent-issued message or attachment requires `agentID`, `agentName` and `isPrivate` parameters. Messages without these parameters are considered as requester-issued. These rules concern both message and attachments events.\n",
        "tags": [
          "Imported tickets"
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ImportedTicketCreate"
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "created ticket",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TicketResult"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
